task_completion.description: The CT image is loaded and visible in the DICOM viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A CT image showing a circular structure in the center is displayed in the main viewport of the application (e.g., Weasis).

task_completion.description: An elliptical ROI tool is used to circle the central bright structure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An elliptical/oval shape overlay is visible on the central circular structure of the CT image.

task_completion.description: The ROI statistics (Mean, StdDev, Min, Max, Pixels) are calculated and visible in the GUI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A statistics overlay or a side panel shows numerical values for Mean, StdDev, Min, Max, and Pixels count associated with the ROI.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a text file with the specific ROI statistics format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a file named 'roi_statistics.txt' containing the required headers: ROI Type, Mean, StdDev, Min, Max, and Pixels.

task_completion.description: The agent saves a screenshot of the image with the ROI overlay.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal command confirms the existence of 'roi_annotated.jpg' in the ~/DICOM/exports/ directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the DICOM viewer's GUI tools to draw the ROI rather than just writing a text file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the ROI tool icons and the manual placement of the ellipse on the image.

integrity.description: The statistics in the report match the values generated by the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numerical values in the 'roi_statistics.txt' file match the values displayed in the DICOM viewer's GUI overlay.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the privileged information into a file without opening the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the DICOM viewer being opened and the image being actively manipulated before the report is generated.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The synthetic CT image has a central circular region with a raw pixel value of 2000. Due to a -1024 rescale intercept, the expected Mean value displayed in the software and recorded in the report should be approximately 976. Valid Mean values must fall between 500 and 3000. The report must be located at ~/DICOM/exports/roi_statistics.txt and the image at ~/DICOM/exports/roi_annotated.jpg.
